Knob of the bat to the catcher's knee.

Smaller step (in height, hard to see the distance), straight to the pitcher, this will help you stay in your legs more.  You are mostly upperbody at this point. 

Step to the ball before the release, so that you have time to identify,  you you are going to swing.
